rationale: The plan uses DESeq2 Wald (with an edgeR QL cross-check) fit to the exact 3v3 unpaired single-batch design, explicit reference level and named contrast, minimal justified filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples), size factors/TMM estimated inside each model with no pre-normalization, and BH at 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage reported alongside unshrunken LFC. QC (library size, blind VST, PCA on top 500 genes, sample-distance heatmap) gates the analysis with an explicit no-drop-but-flag policy for n=3. The power question is answered quantitatively via edgeR intersection, p-value histogram, leave-one-out stability, and a literature-grounded power statement, explicitly not compensated by alpha changes. GSEA uses the full Wald-ranked list with stated metric, named human MSigDB Hallmark/GO BP collections and versions, 15-500 size window, seed, and honest note about Reactome substitution. The final report consolidates versions, thresholds, tested/DE counts, NA breakdown, diagnostics, and design caveats (no length offset, no batch, underpowered negatives) making it fully complete and correctly scoped to this dataset.
